lines.ruling: Ruling: scope; i1040gi p. 110, Schedule 1-A, line 22, column (ii), "deducted elsewhere on your return (for example, on Schedule C, Schedule E, or Schedule F)". Schedules E and F are outside the tool: rental and farm income are refused through scope.schedule1 (scope.rental, scope.farm), so on a completed return Schedule C is the only place QPVLI can be deducted elsewhere, and the English counts it. The model agrees that the pro rata limit to the qualifying part is consistent with the column. Same as the earlier rounds.
